questions.question: Train A passes an electric pole in 15 seconds, moving at 60 kmh. It crosses train B moving in the opposite direction at 48 km/h, in 19 seconds. What is the length (in m) of train B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Length of Train A = Speed × Time = (60 × 5/18) × 15 = 250 m

Relative speed (opposite direction) = (60 + 48) × 5/18 = 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

Total distance (Length of Train A + Length of Train B) = Relative speed × Time = 30 × 19 = 570 m

Length of Train B = 570 − 250 = 320 m

**∴ The correct answer is 320 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Train A (SA) = 60 km/h

Time taken by Train A to cross an electric pole = 15 s

Speed of Train B (SB) = 48 km/h

Time taken by both trains to cross each other = 19 s

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × (5/18)

Relative Speed (opposite directions) = SA + SB

**Calculations:**

 
• 
 
 
 Train A
 60 km/h →
 Length = 250 m
 
 
 Train B
 ← 48 km/h
 Length = ?
 
 Relative Speed = 108 km/h | Time = 19 s

⇒ Speed of Train A in m/s = 60 × 5/18 = 50/3 m/s

⇒ Length of Train A (LA) = Speed × Time = (50/3) × 15 = 250 m

⇒ Relative speed of Train A and Train B = 60 + 48 = 108 km/h

⇒ Relative speed in m/s = 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

⇒ Total distance covered during crossing = LA + LB

⇒ Total Distance = Relative speed × Time

⇒ 250 + LB = 30 × 19

⇒ 250 + LB = 570

⇒ LB = 570 − 250 = 320 m

**∴ The correct answer is 320 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Directions)

When two bodies move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds: Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂|

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert speed from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Train Crossing Concepts

When a train crosses a stationary object of negligible length (like an electric pole or a standing man), the distance traveled is equal to the length of the train itself. When crossing another train or a platform, the distance traveled is the sum of their lengths: L₁ + L₂.

questions.question: The average of 19 numbers is 24. The average of the first 8 numbers is 26.5 and that of the last 12 numbers is 21.5. If the 8th number is excluded, then what will be the average (correct to one decimal point) of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of 19 numbers is 24. 

The average of the first 8 numbers is 26.5 and that of the last 12 numbers is 21.5.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

Sum of the first 8 numbers i.e. 1st + 2nd + .... + 8th

⇒ 26.5 × 8 = 212

Sum of the last 12 numbers i.e. 19th + 18th + ... + 8th

⇒ 21.5 × 12 = 258

Sum of all 19 numbers i.e. (1st + 2nd + ... + 8th + ... + 19th)

⇒ 19 × 24 = 456

According to the question,

(1st + 2nd + .... + 8th) + (19th + 18th + ... + 8th) = 212 + 258

⇒ (1st + 2nd + ... + 8th + ... + 19th) + 8th = 470

⇒ (1st + 2nd + ... + 8th + ... + 19th) + 8th = 470

⇒ 456 + 8th = 470

⇒ 8th = 470 - 456

⇒ 8th = 14

Now, excluding the 8th number, the average

⇒ (456 - 14) ÷ (19 - 1)

⇒ 442/18

⇒ 24.55 ≈ 24.6

∴ Excluding the 8th number, the average will be 24.6.

questions.question: A shopkeeper gives 17% discount on the discounted price after giving an initial discount of 12% on the marked price of a refrigerator. If the final sale price is Rs. 21,912, the marked price (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A shopkeeper gives 17% discount on the discounted price

An initial discount of 12% on the marked price of a refrigerator.

Final selling price = Rs. 21,912

Concept used:

Selling price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

Final discount percentage after two successive discounts of A% and B% = (A + B - {AB over 100})\% 

Calculation:

Final discount percentage = {12 + 17 - (12 × 17)/100}}% = 26.96%

Let the marked price be M.

According to the concept,

M - M × 26.96% = 21912

⇒ M × 0.7304 = 21912

⇒ M = 21912/0.7304

⇒ M = 30,000

∴ The marked price of the item was Rs. 30,000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

The first discount is 12% = (3)/(25) 

The second discount is 17% = (17)/(100)

⇒ MP times (22)/(25) times (83)/(100) = 21912 

⇒ MP =( 21912times 25×100)/(22×83) 

⇒ MP = **30,000.**

questions.question: A calculates his profit percentage on the selling price of an article, whereas B calculates his profit on the cost price of the same article. The selling price of both of them is the same and both get 40% profit. If the difference between their profits is Rs. 120, then the selling price (in Rs.) of the article is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The selling price of both of them is the same and both get 40% profit. 

The difference between their profits is Rs. 120.

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Profit%)

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

Calculation:

Let the seling price of the article for both A and B be Q.

Cost price for A = Q - Q × 40%

⇒ 0.6Q

Profit of A = Q - 0.6Q

⇒ 0.4Q = 4Q/10

Cost price of B = Q ÷ (1 + 40%)

⇒ Q/(1 + 0.4)

⇒ Q/1.4

⇒ 5Q/7

Profit of B = Q - 5Q/7

⇒ 2Q/7

According to the question,

4Q/10 - 2Q/7 = 120

⇒ (28Q - 20Q)/70 = 120

⇒ 8Q = 120 × 70

⇒ Q = 8400/8

⇒ Q = 1050

∴ The selling price of the article is Rs. 1,050.

questions.question: The ratio of efficiencies of X and Y for doing a certain work is 5 ∶ 9. Working together, they can complete a work in 15 days. X alone will complete 66(2)/(3)\% of the same work in?
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of efficiencies of X and Y for doing a certain work is 5 ∶ 9. 

Working together, they complete a work = 15 days

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency × total time 

Calculation:

According to the question, 

Total efficiency of X & Y = ( 5 + 9) = 14 units

Total time taken by both X & Y together = 15 days 

Total work = 14 × 15 = 210 units.

Now,

X alone can complete 66(2)/(3)\% of the total work means,

Total work × 66(2)/(3)\% 

⇒ 210 × 66(2)/(3)\%

⇒ 210 × 200/300 = 140 units

Time taken by X to complete 140 units,

⇒ 140/5 = 28 days.

**∴ X will complete 66(2)/(3)\% of the same work in 28 days.**

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 ∶ 9. If their HCF is 14, then what is their LCM?
questions.solution:
Given:

Two numbers are in the ratio 5 ∶ 9. 

Their HCF is 14.

Concept used:

HCF of two or more numbers is the greatest factor that divides the numbers.

LCM is the smallest common multiple of two or more numbers.

Calculation:

According to the concept,

The first number = 5 × 14 = 70

The second number = 9 × 14 = 126

70 = 2 × 5 × 7

126 = 2 × 3² × 7

LCM (70, 126) = 2 × 3² × 5 × 7

⇒ 630

∴ Their LCM is 630.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let the two number be 5x & 9x

HCF = 14 and,

The HCF of 5x and 9x is x = 14

So, LCM = (x) × 5 × 9

⇒ 14 × 5 × 9 =** 630.**

questions.question: The ages of Ramesh and his wife are 40 years and 36 years, respectively. If the average age of their son and 2 daughters is 13 years, then what is the average age of the family?
questions.solution:

Ages of Ramesh and his wife are 40 years and 36 years, respectively. 

Average age of their son and 2 daughters is 13 years.

Concept used:

Total sum = Average × Number of entities.

Calculation:

According to the question,

Sum of the age of their children = 13 × 3 = 39 years

Sum of the age of all family members = 40 + 36 + 39 = 115 years

Now, the average age of the family = 115/5 = 23 years

∴ The average age of the family is 23 years.

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 1,727 is divided into three parts A, B and C so that their amounts after 3, 4 and 5 years, respectively, are equal, the rate of simple interest being 5% per annum. How much is A?
questions.solution:
Given:

A sum of Rs. 1,727 is divided into three parts A, B and C so that their amounts after 3, 4 and 5 years, respectively, are equal, the rate of simple interest being 5% per annum.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

According to the question,

A + (A × 5 × 3)/100 = B + (B × 5 × 4)/100 = C + (C × 5 × 5)/100

⇒ A + 15A/100 = B + 20B/100 = C + 25C/100

⇒ 115A = 120B = 125C

⇒ 23A = 24B = 25C

⇒ 23A/13800 = 24B/13800 = 25C/13800

⇒ A/600 = B/575 = C/552 = k (let)

So, A = 600k, B = 575k, and C = 552k

According to the question,

A + B + C = 1727

⇒ 600k + 575k + 552k = 1727

⇒ 1727k = 1727

⇒ k = 1

Now, the part A = 600 × 1 = Rs. 600

∴ The amount of part A is Rs. 600.

questions.question: A person lent a certain sum of money at 5% simple interest. If the interest after 6 years is Rs. 5,600 less than the sum lent, then what is the sum lent?
questions.solution:
Given:

Person lent a sum money at 5% simple interest. 

The interest after 6 years is Rs. 5,600 less than the sum lent.

Concept used:

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI, where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount be Q.

According to the question,

(Q × 5 × 6)/100 = Q - 5600

⇒ 0.3Q = Q - 5600

⇒ Q - 0.3Q = 5600

⇒ 0.7Q = 5600

⇒ Q = 5600/0.7

⇒ Q = 8,000

∴ The sum was Rs. 8,000.

questions.question: Find the greatest possible length which can be used to measure exactly the lengths 4 m 90 cm, 3 m 85 cm and 12 m 95 cm.
questions.solution:
Given:

Given lengths = 4 m 90 cm, 3 m 85 cm and 12 m 95 cm.

Concept used:

HCF is the largest number or quantity that is a factor of each member of a group of numbers.

Calculation:

According to the question,

4 m 90 cm = 490 cm

3 m 85 cm = 385 cm

12 m 95 cm = 1295 cm

HCF (490, 385, 1295) = 35

**∴ The greatest possible length can be used to measure exactly the lengths 4 m 90 cm, 3 m 85 cm, and 12 m 95 cm, is 35 cm.**

questions.question: An automobile financier claims to be lending money at simple interest, but he includes the interest every six months for calculating the principal. If he is charging an interest of 14%, the effective rate of interest becomes:
questions.solution:
Given:

Claimed rate of interest = 14%

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI, where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount be Rs. 100.

So, after the first 6 months, the interest incurred

⇒ (100 × 14 × 6/12)/100 = Rs. 7

For the next 6 months, the principal = 100 + 7 = Rs. 107

So, after the next 6 months, the interest incurred

⇒ (107 × 14 × 6/12)/100 = Rs. 7.49

So, the total interest = 7.49 + 7 = Rs. 14.49

On the principal amount of Rs. 100, the amount of interest is charged Rs. 14.49.

Now, the rate of interest = 14.49%

∴ The simple rate of interest is 14.49% in this case.
